name: ADNEX
recent: ADNEX 近期获得 Bursa Malaysia 价值约 RM14.2 million 的办公室翻新合约，并披露与关联方之间的经常性关联交易累计金额已超过净资产 1%。公司也发布了最新季度业绩，同时市场关注审计事务所 TGS TW 客户变动的影响。
notable: 子公司获得 Bursa Malaysia 价值约 RM14.2 million 的办公室翻新合约。
披露 2026 年 3 月 17 日至 9 月 24 日期间的经常性关联交易累计金额超过 2025 年 12 月 31 日经审计合并净资产的 1%。
risks: 审计事务所 TGS TW 在资深审计师离职后不再为 18 家 Bursa 上市公司提供服务，ADNEX 为其中之一，需关注后续审计安排。

recent_en: ADNEX recently secured an office refurbishment contract from Bursa Malaysia worth approximately RM14.2 million and disclosed that cumulative recurrent related party transactions have exceeded 1% of net assets. The company also released its latest quarterly results, while the market watches the impact of audit firm TGS TW's client changes.
notable_en: A subsidiary secured an office refurbishment contract from Bursa Malaysia worth approximately RM14.2 million.
Disclosed that cumulative recurrent related party transactions from 17 March 2026 to 24 September 2026 exceeded 1% of audited consolidated net assets as at 31 December 2025.
risks_en: Audit firm TGS TW dropped 18 Bursa-listed clients, including ADNEX, after senior auditors departed; the company's subsequent audit arrangements warrant attention.
